text: Sometimes, all I think about is you late nights in the middle of June,

text: heat waves, been faking me out, can’t make you happier now.

text: Usually I put something on TV so we never think about

text: you and me, but today I see our reflections clearly in Hollywood, laying on the screen.

text: You just need a better life than this you need something I can never give.
